khai.tagline: Self-relation as composite: the ways a persona relates to its own self -- evaluating its worth (self-esteem), caring for it in suffering (self-compassion), and being true to it (authenticity) -- three modes with different stabilities that interact into one self-stance, across the modes, fault, and weave bridges, read whole over the engines it depends on (Neff & Vonk; Crocker & Wolfe; Kernis).

card.wire: Attaches at Process, over three atoms it declares as dependencies. The root (process_self_relation.md) reads how a persona relates to its own self as one stance made of three modes: evaluating its worth (the self-esteem engine's), caring for it in suffering (the self-compassion engine's), and being true to it (the authenticity engine's). The three modes are the atoms' own ground -- the judgment is self-esteem's, the warmth self-compassion's, the alignment authenticity's -- and none, alone, sees that a whole self-relation is their weave, nor that they differ in how stable a footing they give. The composite adds no fourth mode, only the stance the three compose and the dynamics among them.
card.issue: Three bridges, each a shape of the self-stance the atoms cannot hold alone. Modes: the three ways of relating to the self held together -- evaluate, care, be-true -- and how a persona's overall self-relation is their particular combination, not any one. Fault: the failure-test, where the modes diverge most sharply -- contingent self-esteem collapses when the success it was staked on fails, self-compassion holds because its care needs no success, and authenticity is tested between owning the failure truly and defending the image (Crocker & Wolfe; Neff & Vonk). Weave: how the modes enable or undercut one another -- self-compassion freeing authenticity by making it safe to be real, authenticity risking the approval contingent esteem depends on, image-protection blocking both.
card.require: Two altitudes hold the composite. The law: declared once in the project's Instructions Knowledge chapter, linking the root, so the whole-self-relation read runs wherever its atoms are cast. The link, advisory: a persona may link the bridge under Projection, and the audit surfaces the ones staged as a single self-feeling when the three modes were live and diverging.
card.enforce: Structure is checked; coherence is judged. The kit verifies the floor: the law is declared, the composite's own members conform, and every hard link into the atoms resolves through a declared dependency. Whether a production's self-relations genuinely weave -- the three modes present, their stabilities distinct, their interactions staged, especially under failure -- is semantic, taught and reviewed, never failed by the suite.
card.setup: Install the composite; its atoms arrive as dependencies and their laws with them. Declare the law in the Instructions Knowledge chapter, linking the root. Cast the three modes from the atoms as usual -- the worth-judgment, the self-warmth, the truth-to-self -- then stage the stance: which modes are operative, which footing they rest on, and how they interact, especially at the fault line of failure where they diverge. Read the production's self-relation as a weave of the three, never flattened to one. The content of who the persona is is the identity engine's; the self-evaluative emotions of guilt, shame, and pride are the self-conscious composite's; the disordered grandiose-fragile self-relation is the narcissism engine's. This composite owns the healthy structure of how a self relates to itself.
